name: Render
tagline: Cloud apps, jobs, databases, API, CLI, and MCP server.
shortDescription: Render provides app hosting, managed databases, deployment API, CLI, IaC-style blueprints, and an open MCP server.
agentSummary: Agents can inspect services, deploy from images, manage env vars, and use API/CLI workflows with review.
bestFor: Web services, background workers, cron jobs, managed databases, and deployment automation.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Deploys, env vars, and deletion operations should be reviewed. Schema changes, migrations, deletes, backups, row-level security, and retention policies need explicit review before agents touch production data. MCP servers inherit the connected account's scopes and may send prompts or data to third-party services; configure read-only or narrow scopes when available. CLI access is powerful but can run destructive local or production commands; prefer dry runs, preview environments, and non-production credentials.
pricingSummary: Public pricing by service type and resource class.
authModel: API keys, workspace permissions, REST API tokens, and Render MCP API-key auth.
browserSupport: Dashboard helps inspect logs, deploys, env vars, and billing.

capabilities.detail: Render CLI can authenticate with API keys and deploy image-backed services.
Render API supports services, deploys, jobs, environment variables, and databases.
Official hosted Render MCP server manages Render services, databases, metrics, and logs from compatible agent clients.
Docs include API, CLI, deploys, logs, and blueprints.
Public pricing by service type and resource class.
Dashboard helps inspect logs, deploys, env vars, and billing.
The tool has documented test, local, preview, self-hosted, or staging paths that let agents validate changes away from production.
